read.en: Nvidia fell 0.6% on Oct 23 to $210.96, trading between $210.18 and $213.85. It is below the falling 5-day ($215.7), 10-day ($218.6), 30-day ($224.0) and 100-day ($214.4) averages, and above the rising 200-day ($203.7). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and is below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($231.14), and RSI is 38.

The close slipped under the $211.3 Oct 22 low, now resistance. Resistance is $211.3–214.4 (Oct 22 low, Oct 23 high, 100-day), then $215.7–218.9 (5 and 10-day, Oct 22 high) and $224 (30-day). Support is $210.2 (Oct 23 low), then $207.3–208.9 (Aug 24 and Sep 14 lows) and $203.7 (200-day). A close below $207 would open $203.7; a close above $214.4 would target $218.9.
